E; and compression codecs

A HQ 1080p video file will be around ~8GB, which makes 4k HQ video end up being ~36GB. The codec being used will probably be able to 'compress' the 4k video a lot more - down to 22-25GB - since more pixels will share the same values.

Some codecs don't scale well with pixels because they compress them in groups of limited size (8x8 for jpeg for example), so going to higher resolutions each of these groups cover less area compared to the whole image.
